summary: A nonzero good form z in the p-part gives an algebraic form L z of some weight, with a good label c at the chosen places; its attached ℓ-adic representation is a labelled column for the untwisted j-th pair with the apt labels c, its traces are the Hecke values, and its jumps are those of the rows; exists_row_for_all_twists gives the row.

steps.claim: Take a nonzero good form z on W_m in the p-part (hz good, hp in the p-part, z0 ≠ 0), and a weight (d, κ) of which the doubled parameter paramW is twice the Harish-Chandra parameter (exists_isHCParam_of_hasGap, the gap of paramW: hasGap_signsY_paramW).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨z, ⟨hz, hp⟩, z0⟩, d, κ, hκ⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 H,
    exists_isHCParam_of_hasGap D.hasGap_signsY_paramW

steps.claim: Let L be the isomorphism toAlgForm from forms of type paramW on W_m to algebraic forms of weight (d, κ), as a linear map into functions.
L intertwines right translations: L(R(g)y) = R(g)(L y) (toAlgForm_formRep).
steps.lean: have ρ g y : L _ = rightRegular ℂ _ _ g (L y) := congr($(toAlgForm_formRep hκ ..).1)

steps.claim: L z is fixed by the principal level at the chosen places (K), is an algebraic form of weight (d, κ) (hf), and some good tuple of labels c (hc: c ∈ goodTupleFamilies) has an idempotent that does not kill z (hl): z = e₀z ≠ 0 since z is good and e₀ is a central idempotent, and e₀ = Σ_c e_c.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨K : L z ∈ levelSpace (rightRegular ℂ ..) D.chosenLevel, hf : _ ∈ forms _ (d, κ), c : ∀ x,
    (ResField ((auxPair ..).chosenPlace x))[X], hc, hl⟩ := by simp [← ρ, mem_levelSpace.1 z.2],
    (toAlgForm _ hκ z.1).2, D.goodTupleFamilies.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero
    (by simpa [e₀] using ((D.isCentralProj_e₀.1.map _).mem_range_iff.1 hz).trans_ne z0)

steps.claim: L z is an eigenform for the system w ↦ (Hecke polynomial with coefficients p(w, ·)): at every place w split off level, L z is spherical (levelSpace_anti, maxCompactAt_le_levelOf) and T_{w,i}(L z) = p(w, i)·L z because z lies in the eigenspace of heckeOperator (w, i) for p(w, i) and L commutes with the Hecke operators (map_heckeSplit) (isEigenform_of_hasHeckePolyAt).
steps.lean:
have E := D.isEigenform_of_hasHeckePolyAt (by simpa [L]) fun w a ↦ ⟨levelSpace_anti
    (maxCompactAt_le_levelOf a.2) K, (p ⟨w, ·⟩), rfl, fun i ↦ map_heckeSplit _ i L ▸ by
    simp [by simpa [heckeOperator, a, Subtype.ext_iff] using (Submodule.mem_iInf _).1 hp (w, i)]⟩

steps.claim: The labels c are apt for the untwisted j-th auxiliary pair (isApt_auxPair D 1 j), and some ℓ-adic representation R is attached to the eigensystem of L z (sphericalCompat_std).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨a, R, h⟩ := isApt_auxPair D 1 j hc, (sphericalCompat_std ofNonempty hf E).1

steps.claim: By exists_row_for_all_twists (with ι and the apt labels c) it suffices that R is a labelled column with labels c and empty level, that its traces are the limits of ιℓ(p(w, 1)) along Frobenii, and that its shifted jumps satisfy IsRowType.

R is a labelled column with labels c_i·(X − 1)^0 (isLabelledColumn_of_hasProductLabel): L z is spherical at the places off the chosen ones (levelSpace_anti, maxCompactAt_le_levelOf) and has the product label c_i at each chosen place: the parahoric type of the principal level is given by the action of GL_r(k_w) through reduction (apply_liftResidue_eq, reduceFamily_atSplit), e_{c_i} does not kill z (hl, piTensorElem_apply_eq_zero), and HasParahoricType.hasProductLabel gives the label; the empty families of additional characters are vacuous.
steps.lean:
convert isLabelledColumn_of_hasProductLabel a hf E h (fun _ _ b ↦
    levelSpace_anti (maxCompactAt_le_levelOf b) K) fun i ↦ HasParahoricType.hasProductLabel (e :=
    .refl _) (b := 0) (s := 0) (ψ := 1) (L.domRestrict _) (fun _ ↦ by simp [L])
    (hl <| piTensorElem_apply_eq_zero i ·) ⟨by simp, fun k _ _ e ↦ by
    simpa [-GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply] using ρ .. ▸ congr(L $(apply_liftResidue_eq _ _
      ((reduceFamily_atSplit ..).trans (congrArg _ (Units.ext e))))).symm⟩ nofun nofun

steps.claim: The labels and jumps of step 8 are those required.

Traces: tr R(g) = −(coefficient of X^{r−1} of det(X − R(g))) is the limit of −ιℓ of the corresponding Hecke coefficient, which is ιℓ(p(w, 1)), along Frobenii (Attached.tendsto_charpoly_coeff; |RowIndex(D)| = r, r odd).
Unfold the jumps of the weight κ, the auxiliary pair and rankDiff = t.
The shifted jumps are the multisets of isRowType_auxPair j (the r integers ⌊t/2⌋ − cmSign(σ)·(ς_q + w_j(σ))), which satisfy IsRowType D r t; it remains to match each jump.
steps.lean: convert isRowType_auxPair j.2 using 3 with σ q i

steps.claim: paramW at the basis vector q is the Harish-Chandra parameter of (d, κ) at its decreasing position (IsHCParam.eq_hcParameter).
With step 13 the shifted jump at q is ⌊t/2⌋ − cmSign(σ)·(ς_q + w_j(σ)), by the definitions of the basis vectors, of paramW and of its decreasing positions (decrPosition_paramW).
steps.lean:
simp [cmSign, apply_ite, hcParameter, diagramWeight_apply, ↓card_rowIndex] at *; clear * - this
    i; grind [Data.basisVec, paramW, decrPosition_paramW]
